summary: test_a_restarted_server_loses_nothing cannot see the same-batch retry: deleting it leaves the test green
evidence: removed the retry block in embed_safe (recall/embed.py:96-99); pytest tests/test_embed.py -> 16 passed. One failed call then bisection into two good halves still keeps 8 of 8, so the test checks the count, not that the same batch was retried.
